offerings.name: Reader API https://s.jina.ai
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage. Prototype Development: $50 / 1 Billion Tokens (0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: $500 / 11 Billion Tokens (0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens! Toy Experiment: 10 Million Tokens; Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC). Free.
offerings.output_type: 搜索网页并返回前五个结果；每项包含 URL 和干净、LLM-friendly 文本。JSON 模式返回五项列表，每项含 URL、title、content 和 timestamp（如可用）。
offerings.note: 每次请求固定消耗 token，starting from 10000 tokens；免费/付费 key 100 RPM，Premium key 1000 RPM。
